CCK structure redesign · Phase 1 design canvas · 5 Sep 2026

Structure borrowed from africahackon (full-bleed hero, overlapping stats card, framed intro photo, photo grid, supporter wall, FAQ, CTA band). Skin is Karibu: paper, clay, Newsreader + Inter, exactly the tokens in globals.css.

Dashed chips mark SLOTS (video, reel, logos, screenshots). Bracketed text marks facts Peter supplies. Photos are the real ones already on the site.
Dark board uses the data-theme=dark tokens. Fixed slabs (ticker, card 03, CTA band, footer) stay #A84E2D / #23201B in both themes, like the live footer does.

390 px: compact top bar (logo · search · theme · menu), full-width 48 px buttons, hero poster only. A pinned bottom bar (Home · Events · Learn · Join) slides in once the hero scrolls away, drawn here at scroll position 844: Join and Events stay one thumb away without duplicating the hero CTAs.

Menu open: full-screen sheet with backdrop blur over the page. Five serif sections with sub-items visible without a second tap, city chips, Join buttons pinned at the bottom, Sign in as text. Dark variant below uses the same tokens (paper on ink).

Inner-page template: PageBanner (tinted photo + breadcrumb + H1) → body → CtaBand → footer. Upcoming shows the designed empty state. Every past card has art: uploaded poster where one exists, generated Karibu cover otherwise.
